# Existing HTMX runtime

`htmx.min.js` is the existing, unmodified **HTMX 1.9.12** distribution. It matched <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx.org@1.9.12/dist/htmx.min.js> byte-for-byte. This packaging change makes the referenced shell enhancement available to clean checkouts; it is not a version upgrade.

The accompanying `LICENSE` is the pinned upstream **Zero-Clause BSD** license from <https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/htmx.org@1.9.12/LICENSE>.
